title: Catch Order Matters
prompt: Given the family above, implement classify(fn) that calls fn() and returns 'validation' if it raises ValidationError, 'notfound' if NotFoundError, 'app' for any other AppError, and 'unknown' for anything else.

tests.name: specific before base
tests.code:
def f(): raise ValidationError('v')
assert classify(f) == 'validation'
tests.hint: The ValidationError handler must come before the AppError handler.

tests.name: falls back through the family
tests.hint: Each family member maps to its own label.

tests.name: foreign errors are unknown
tests.code:
def f(): raise KeyError('k')
assert classify(f) == 'unknown'
tests.hint: Only AppError family maps to app labels.
